name: 43209 · Columbus, OH
findings: ZIP 43209 (Columbus) has 158 nonprofit organizations. 63 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 52 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43209 (Columbus) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 43209 (Columbus) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
